A brushed brass gooseneck faucet with cross handles is centered on the sink. A window at the far right edge admits soft natural daylight. A woven light-toned bath mat is partially visible at floor level. The palette is warm neutral — sand plaster, walnut wood, white marble, with warm amber light accents. The mood is serene and quietly luxurious. Object density is low.
